asked.item: Search the Inspiration database for meal prep viral posts through Claude with the Blotato MCP server
Doing it the way they do in the web app

verdict.reason: S8 states the MCP tool catalog has no Inspiration Database search tool, and S2 and S4 cover searching topics in the web app.

steps.text: The MCP tool catalog does not expose an Inspiration Database search tool, so Claude can't search it through the Blotato MCP server.
In the web app, the Inspiration guides show how to search topics or find a creator.
